summary.narrative: Inspection identified 15 verified checks. 3 require immediate remediation to prevent lead leakage, 12 affect conversion consistency or search visibility, and 0 passed technical standards.

revenueImpact.title: LEAD & REVENUE LEAKAGE DETECTED
revenueImpact.description: Phone number is unclickable plain text: High bounce rate on mobile; direct commercial lead loss.

customerJourneys.name: Journey A — New Visitor
customerJourneys.notes: Indirect proxy: Evaluates value proposition clarity and whether visitor finds primary CTA without friction.

customerJourneys.name: Journey B — Inquiring Lead
customerJourneys.flow: Homepage → Contact Form / Phone → Submission → Notification
customerJourneys.notes: Indirect proxy: Tests whether contact channel elements exist in the DOM (actual message receipt requires manual audit).

customerJourneys.name: Journey C — Mobile Customer
customerJourneys.flow: 320px Mobile Screen → Touch CTA → Dial / Chat Conversion
customerJourneys.notes: Directly measured: Verifies tap-to-call tel: links and mobile viewport layout at compact 320px.

customerJourneys.name: Journey D — Returning User
customerJourneys.flow: Direct URL → Cached State → Fast Navigation
customerJourneys.notes: Directly measured: Validates browser caching headers, compression, and Lighthouse performance scores.

customerJourneys.name: Journey E — Failure Recovery
customerJourneys.flow: Input Error / Non-existent Route → Helpful Guidance → Retry
customerJourneys.notes: Directly measured: Checks authentic HTTP 404 status response on non-existent test routes.

findings.headline: Phone number is unclickable plain text
findings.evidence: Detected phone 1184720131 in page text, but 0 <a href="tel:"> links exist.
findings.userImpact: Mobile visitors tapping the phone number cannot initiate a call.
findings.businessImpact: High bounce rate on mobile; direct commercial lead loss.
findings.recommendation: Wrap visible phone numbers in <a href="tel:+1..."> with clean international dialer formatting.

findings.headline: Content-Security-Policy absent
findings.userImpact: Impacts user experience and interaction reliability.
findings.businessImpact: Causes customer friction and potential bounce.
findings.recommendation: Implement a Content-Security-Policy to protect against cross-site scripting (XSS) and data injection.

findings.headline: Missing X-Content-Type-Options
findings.userImpact: Impacts user experience and interaction reliability.
findings.businessImpact: Causes customer friction and potential bounce.
findings.recommendation: Set X-Content-Type-Options to "nosniff" to prevent MIME-confusion attacks.

findings.headline: Server version exposed
findings.userImpact: Impacts user experience and interaction reliability.
findings.businessImpact: Causes customer friction and potential bounce.
findings.recommendation: Disable or mask the Server header to prevent fingerprinting by automated scanners.

findings.headline: Missing SPF record
findings.evidence: No TXT record starting with v=spf1 found
findings.userImpact: Impacts user experience and interaction reliability.
findings.businessImpact: Causes customer friction and potential bounce.
findings.recommendation: Configure an SPF record to protect domain against email spoofing.

findings.headline: Missing meta description
findings.userImpact: Impacts user experience and interaction reliability.
findings.businessImpact: Causes customer friction and potential bounce.
findings.recommendation: Add an intent-focused meta description between 120–160 characters.

findings.headline: Missing <h1> heading
findings.evidence: Page does not contain an <h1> tag
findings.userImpact: Impacts user experience and interaction reliability.
findings.businessImpact: Causes customer friction and potential bounce.
findings.recommendation: Add a single primary <h1> element representing the main topic.

findings.headline: Missing canonical URL
findings.userImpact: Impacts user experience and interaction reliability.
findings.businessImpact: Causes customer friction and potential bounce.
findings.recommendation: Specify a self-referencing canonical tag to prevent duplicate content indexing.

findings.headline: Missing <meta name="viewport"> tag
findings.evidence: No viewport meta tag declared in document head
findings.userImpact: Mobile browsers render the desktop site zoomed out at 980px width, causing tiny text and broken touch targets.
findings.businessImpact: Severe mobile user drop-off and mobile ranking penalties from Google.
findings.recommendation: Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"> to document <head>.

findings.headline: Incomplete Open Graph tags
findings.userImpact: Impacts user experience and interaction reliability.
findings.businessImpact: Causes customer friction and potential bounce.
findings.recommendation: Add og:title, og:description, and og:image to ensure rich previews when shared on WhatsApp/social media.

findings.headline: Images without explicit width/height
findings.evidence: 6 images lack width and height attributes (CLS risk)
findings.userImpact: Impacts user experience and interaction reliability.
findings.businessImpact: Causes customer friction and potential bounce.
findings.recommendation: Include explicit width and height dimensions to prevent cumulative layout shifts.

findings.headline: Phone number found as plain unclickable text
findings.evidence: Phone detected in body text (1184720131) but no tel: links exist in DOM
findings.userImpact: Impacts user experience and interaction reliability.
findings.businessImpact: Causes customer friction and potential bounce.
findings.recommendation: Wrap visible phone numbers in <a href="tel:..."> so mobile visitors can tap to call.

findings.headline: Missing structured data (JSON-LD) for AI search engines
findings.evidence: No application/ld+json structured schema found in document
findings.userImpact: AI search bots (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Google Search Generative) struggle to parse business entities.
findings.businessImpact: Reduced visibility in generative AI search summaries and rich SERP snippets.
findings.recommendation: Add Schema.org JSON-LD structured data (Organization, LocalBusiness, or Product).

findings.headline: Missing mobile touch icon / web manifest
findings.evidence: No <link rel="apple-touch-icon"> or manifest.json declared in <head>
findings.userImpact: Impacts user experience and interaction reliability.
findings.businessImpact: Causes customer friction and potential bounce.
findings.recommendation: Add apple-touch-icon and web app manifest for crisp home-screen bookmarks on iOS and Android.

findings.headline: Missing structured data (Schema.org)
findings.evidence: No JSON-LD schema found on page
findings.userImpact: Impacts user experience and interaction reliability.
findings.businessImpact: Causes customer friction and potential bounce.
findings.recommendation: Add Organization or LocalBusiness Schema.org JSON-LD to enhance rich snippets and AI discoverability.
